name: player_team pass yards from plays range year_offset sums additive measure over window
description: Additive team measure, player variant: a multi-year year_offset range projects year+week onto the base CTE so the pid-keyed gamelogs join is valid, then SUMs the team measure across the offset window (no num/den; the additive measure pools by SUM).
expected_query: with "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225" as materialized (select "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", SUM(pass_yards) AS team_pass_yds_from_plays, "nfl_plays"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_plays"."week" from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024, 2025) group by "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team", "nfl_plays"."season_year", "nfl_plays"."week"), "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225_player_team_stats" as materialized (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", sum(t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225.team_pass_yds_from_plays) as team_pass_yds_from_plays from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "player_gamelogs"."esbid" = "nfl_games"."esbid" inner join "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225" on "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team" = "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225"."nfl_team" and "nfl_games"."season_year" = "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225"."year" and "nfl_games"."week" = "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225"."week" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2024, 2025) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2024, 2025) group by "player_gamelogs"."pid") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, (SELECT SUM(t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225_player_team_stats.team_pass_yds_from_plays) FROM t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225_player_team_stats WHERE t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225_player_team_stats.pid = player.pid) AS "team_pass_yds_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
